Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-guapuscal-bajo-segment-piman-cara.story: From Tangua it runs 293 km to Tangua; allow about 5 h 03 of riding. It goes by way of Segment Mariscal Sucre - El Tambo, Segment Pimán - Caranqui and back through Segment Mariscal Sucre - El Tambo. The highest point is about 3,300 m. It crosses from Colombia into Ecuador - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
